exercises.question: Which construction represents natural Hungarian agent-backgrounding instead of passive voice?
What does '-ásra/-ésre kerül' express in official Hungarian prose?
options: administrative passive-avoidance (an action being performed or implemented)
a spatial movement into a room

exercises.sentence: A diktatúrában a sajtó-____ minden rendszerkritikus cikket megsemmisített. (censorship)
exercises.english: Under the dictatorship, press censorship destroyed every article critical of the regime.

exercises.sentence: A kényes kérdés a jövő heti konferencián érdemben megvitatásra ____. (will be / comes)
exercises.english: The delicate question will be discussed in earnest at next week's conference.

exercises.sentence: Úgy tűnik, hogy a döntés ____ túlzott óvatosságból fakadt. (somewhat)
exercises.english: It seems that the decision stemmed somewhat from excessive caution.
